Hi all —

We have Samira Khan (Senior ML Engineer) confirmed for a compact virtual onsite next Thursday. She can do a morning block PST. Hiring manager asks to keep the flow tight: three focused slots (40 min each) with 10-min breaks for quick notes/standby. Proposed times (PST):

- Slot A: 09:30 — 10:10 PST (Architecture + System design) — Laura lead
- Slot B: 10:20 — 11:00 PST (Modeling + Eval) — Jonas lead
- Slot C: 11:10 — 11:50 PST (Product & cross-team + culture) — Marissa lead

Candidate is in EST but can do PST mornings. Samira asked for 2-hour total max; this schedule gives 2h with micro-buffers.

Please confirm:
- "OK" if you can own the listed slot,
- or swap suggestion if you'd prefer a different order,
- if you can be the backup for any slot (we may need one stand-in on 30m notice).

I've attached Samira's resume, the draft agenda, and a small roster file for standby assignments. I'll send calendar invite + Zoom after we confirm order.

Also — quick ask: fill the shared debrief sheet within 2 hours after your slot. We want to sync for a 20-min debrief at 12:10 PST (optional if we can decide).

Thanks — Tessa
